expectations.text: Caps the number of splits at what the single named refresh owner can maintain, advising against taking every proposed split at once
expectations.evidence: The "Splits: cap it to what one person can actually maintain" section explicitly ties the cap to the manual refresh reality ("refresh here is manual ('whenever I remember') — no automated sync, no second person") and quotes the two-splits-is-fine/six-is-a-part-time-job guidance. It then rejects taking all proposed splits at once via a per-split table: country = mandatory, product line = deferred to phase 2 ("doubles refresh load on day one"), high-AOV = one-time split test rather than a standing audience, language = dropped.
